source.notes: Official CISCE item bank 'Competency-Focused Practice Questions, ISC-Class XII, Physics' (preface by the Chief Executive & Secretary dated August 2024; file uploaded to cisce.org in 2025/04). It is a question bank, not an examination paper: examYear is null, no maximum marks or duration are printed. 61 PDF pages: preface (p1), contents (p3), questions on printed pages 1-42 (PDF pages 4-45; PDF page = printed page + 3), Answer Key on printed pages 43-57 (PDF pages 46-60). 95 questions in six sections, with marks printed in each section header: I Multiple Choice Questions (Q1-21, 1 mark each), II Assertion-Reason (Q22-25, 1 mark each), III Very Short Answer (Q26-45, 1 mark each), IV Short Answer (Q46-65, 2 marks each), V Long Answer (Q66-90, 3 marks each), VI Very Long Answer (Q91-95, 5 marks each); marksSource is SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS; the 185-mark total is just the sum of the bank. Marks are given per question, not per sub-part, so multi-part questions are kept as one entry. Each question prints a topic tag in square brackets (e.g. [Optics]) and a cognitive domain in parentheses, recorded as cognitiveLevel. Some topic tags do not match the content (e.g. magnetic-field questions tagged as electromagnetic induction); chapters follow the content and such cases are noted in extractionIssues. officialAnswer comes from the bank's own Answer Key, which 'presents the possible answers to a given question, but it is neither limiting nor exhaustive'; it is copied as printed (including its own slips) and never extended. Answers that are diagrams only (Q30, Q37, Q38, Q62) are omitted. Equations, powers of ten, subscripts and vectors were rebuilt inline from the rendered pages where the text layer flattened them; those entries are MEDIUM and flagged.
